description: Search marketplace products by free-text query, optional category, or seller. Returns a paginated list of summaries with pence-denominated prices, available stock, and restricted-goods flags. Pass a concise phrase, not a full sentence.

category.description: Category slug to filter by (see catalog_list_categories); unknown slugs return no hits.

category_subtree.description: When true, also match products in descendant categories of `category`. Defaults to false.

certifications.description: Only products carrying at least one of these certification strings.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from next_cursor in the previous page; omit for the first page.

improves_on_statutory.description: When true, only products whose return policy improves on the statutory minimum.

min_seller_tier.description: Minimum seller verification tier: basic (default) < verified < premium.

q.description: Free-text query matched case-insensitively against product title and description.

restricted.description: Restricted-goods filter: exclude_age (default) hides age-restricted items, exclude_all hides all restricted, allow hides none.

spec.description: Exact-match filters on category spec fields, as key/value pairs.

spec_max.description: Numeric upper bounds on spec fields; keys must be rangeable for the given leaf `category`.

spec_min.description: Numeric lower bounds on spec fields; keys must be rangeable for the given leaf `category`.

name: catalog_search_products
title: Catalog search products
